elements.title: Salient Statistics—United States
elements.content:
|                                   | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023e |

| Production:                       |      |      |      |      |       |
|   Mine                           |  —   |  —   |  —   |  —   |   —   |

|   Chromite ore (gross weight), dollars per metric ton | 174  | 154  | 201  | 274  |  290  |
|   Ferrochromium (chromium content), dollars per pound⁶ | 1.00 | 0.90 | 1.56 | 3.21 |  3.50 |
|   Chromium metal (gross weight), dollars per pound | 4.13 | 3.22 | 4.35 | 7.12 |  5.50 |
| Stocks, consumer, yearend        |  5   |  6   |  6   |  5   |   5   |
| Net import reliance⁷ as a percentage of apparent consumption | 74   | 73   | 80   | 84   |  74   |
elements.notes:
¹ Secondary production is from recycled materials.
² Includes chromium content of chromium materials.
³ Government stockpile shipments are from the Defense National Stockpile Center.
⁴ Apparent consumption is production plus imports minus exports plus stock changes.
⁵ Prices are average annual prices.
⁶ Ferrochromium prices are for charge chrome.
⁷ Net import reliance is imports minus exports as a percentage of apparent consumption.
